sprite.name: SOLID SNAKE — MGS1
sprite.incarnation: Original bespoke cyborg: navy tactical torso, blue-grey shoulder shells, dark muscle bundles, articulated actuators and calf pistons, reinforced boots; human face and navy bandana retained. Original fan game costume, not a canonical released game incarnation.
